# L1-QM020-THM6-P2-GLEASON

GleasonTheorem.lean proves frame identities after assuming a quadratic ansatz; it does not derive that ansatz from arbitrary frame functions. This stage computes PSD trace-one2x2 quadratic frame values and tomography of the admitted off-diagonal coefficient, with nonunit-frame refusal. Output layout: status;frame2;sum;diag2;fixed_probe;b_reconstructed;matrix4;determinant

Supported: Exact quadratic-frame resolution, positivity determinant and coefficient reconstruction, plus universal quadratic frame identity and known-ansatz reconstruction in Lean.

Remaining: Discharge full Gleason or POVM uniqueness with its dimension and measure hypotheses. A source named Gleason or a quadratic ansatz is not that theorem.
